item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Visual Investigation and Media Evidence (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ARTE-01 Storia dell'arte

The selected candidate will join the LIMINAL research group, contributing primarily to the EU-funded MERIDIAN project (Media Evidence Research Initiative & Digital Investigation Alliance Network). They will coordinate investigations into border violence (broadly understood), producing publishable spatial and visual outputs using forensic and cartographic methods, including GIS, remote sensing and 3D modelling. These outputs will support advocacy, media dissemination, and legal and policy interventions. They will also lead LIMINAL's other project outputs: co-designing a training curriculum, coordinating workshops and online masterclasses, and overseeing the multilingual MERIDIAN Methodology…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Pica Code IR-2026-116 - “Syntax out of Africa. Deep history through human grammars” (DHisGram) (Univ. MODENA e R. E.)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 13:00
Institution: Univ. MODENA e R. E., Reggio Emilia
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GLOT-01 Glottologia e linguistica

Collection and analysis of linguistic data from one of the regions covered by the DHisGram project, contribution of these data to PCM_Hub, and analysis of the phylogenetic structure of the languages studied. This work requires experience in the comparative study of ancient Indo-European languages and ancient and modern Semitic languages. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Understanding and tackling deception in generative AI and digital media (Univ. TORINO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 13:00
Institution: Univ. TORINO, Turin
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/PEMM-01 Arti performative, musicali, cinematografiche e mediali

The rise of generative AI brought renewed emphasis to the problem of deception in synthetic media, such as computer-generated images, texts, music, and videos, and to the potential misuses of the persuasive abilities of chatbots. Surprisingly little efforts, however, have so far been made to develop appropriate conceptual tools to situate and further interrogate the role of deception in AI. The selected candidate will contribute to a wider project addressing the relationships between deception, communication, and generative AI. S/he will conduct empirical research with the use of the talkthrough method (Natale et al., 2026) and will engage theoretically with ongoing discussions about…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Pica Code IR-2026-113 - “Stage diplomacy. Reassessing Italy’s performing arts within the context of international relations” (Acronimo “STACY”) (Univ. MODENA e R. E.)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 13:00
Institution: Univ. MODENA e R. E., Modena
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/PEMM-01 Arti performative, musicali, cinematografiche e mediali

The research assignments primarily entail conducting archival research in Italy and abroad to locate sources (e.g., administrative, financial, and epistolary records) that document the relationship between Italian foreign policy and the performing arts (drama, opera, and so-called "minor" genres) from the second half of the 19th century to the present.
